name: Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry
description:
A paragon knight of the Knights of Beauty who is piously seeking his missing Aeon, Idrila the Beauty.
Forthright and candid, he wanders the cosmos espousing the virtues of Idrila's good name.

skills.name: Piety
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Imbue Devotion
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Hymn of Gorgeous Courage
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Lance's Summon
skills.description: Summons 4 statues of Speartips. If 4 statues of Speartip already exist on the field, use Sweeping Lance.

skills.name: Sweeping Lance
skills.description: Releases the power in the Speartip statue and deals Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Shield's Retribution
skills.description: Releases the power in "The Shield" statue. Commands "The Shield" statue to Taunt the target character directly facing the statue, and adjusts the statue's Weakness Type according to the targets facing it.

skills.name: Strength of Honor
skills.description: Enters an unselectable state. In the next turn, use Undeniable Fate.

skills.name: Soul Regained
skills.description: Regains "Soulfreed" from all statues and Enhances this unit based on the number of "Soulfreed," lasting for 1 turn.

skills.name: Soulfreed
skills.description: Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry will apply "Soulfreed" to the summoned statues. When the unit with "Soulfreed" is defeated, apply "Soul Enhancement" to all targets and increase DMG dealt. If Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry regains "Soulfreed," it will instead increase the DMG dealt by Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry in this turn.

skills.name: Undeniable Fate
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets. Additionally, apply Physical DMG 1 time for every stack of Wreath.

skills.name: Unstoppable Momentum
skills.description: Damage received by Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry is greatly reduced. However, after being Weakness Broken, its action is additionally delayed and it receives more DMG, as well as recovering all targets' Skill Points and activating all targets' Ultimates.

skills.name: Reversal of Fortune
skills.description: The Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry can switch their own <u>Combat Stance</u> in battle and summon different statues to fight. When characters defeat statues in the "Soulfreed" state, DMG dealt by the team in this battle will be increased.

skills.name: Turn Back the Tide
skills.description: When the Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry uses "Soulfreed" in their second phase, they will target all the statues.

skills.name: Stellar Aegis
skills.description: For every unit on the enemy's side of the field aside from the Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Reversal of Fortune
tags.description: Boss Mirage can switch its own <color=#f29e38ff><u>Combat Stance</u></color> in battle and summon different statues to fight. When characters defeat statues in the "Soulfreed" state, DMG dealt by the team in this battle will be increased.

tags.name: Turn Back the Tide
tags.description: When Boss Mirage uses "Soulfreed" in Phase II, it will target <color=#f29e38ff>all</color> statues.

tags.name: Stellar Aegis
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

phases.name: Phase I — Power of Offense and Defense
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon 2 types of units: Speartip and Shield.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the enhanced summons first to weaken Boss Mirage.

texts.description: Defeat enhanced Speartip summons to enhance allies and weaken Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's AoE DMG dealt when Shield summons are present

texts.description: Defeat Shield summons to gain a Shield and effectively increase survivability.

phases.name: Phase II — Battle for Glory
phases.description: Boss Mirage will additionally summon The Honored units.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the enhanced summons first to weaken Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage being unselectable when The Honored summons are present

texts.description: When The Honored summons are present, Boss Mirage cannot be selected. It can only be targeted in the next action or after all The Honored summons are defeated.

skills.name: Counters the massive DMG dealt by Boss Mirage using Undeniable Fate

texts.description: Defeat or break The Honored summons to reduce the DMG dealt by Boss Mirage's Undeniable Fate.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.
Defeat or break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> first to effectively weaken Boss Mirage.
